project: Singapore High-Resolution Generative Diffusion Weather Model
goal: Proof-of-concept probabilistic weather forecasting at 1-2km resolution over Singapore for flash flood early warning

track1_corrdiff_inference.description: Zero-shot CorrDiff NIM API inference on Singapore ERA5 data

track2_radar_nowcaster.description: DDPM diffusion model trained on NEA radar to nowcast 30-90min precipitation

input.resolution_note: Measured from radar.zarr lat/lon on 2026-09-25: 0.290 km per pixel, 34.8 x 62.9 km domain. Previously stated as 1 km, which was wrong by 3.4x.
input.lead_note: Samples use context frames t-6..t-1 and target t+6, so the nominal 30-min lead is 35 min from the last observed frame.

model.architecture: DDPM score-based diffusion with conditioned UNet

checkpointing.strategy: every stage produces a persistent artifact; all scripts are idempotent (skip completed work on re-run)

success_metrics.corrdiff_track: visually plausible 2km precipitation field vs NEA radar ground truth
success_metrics.nowcaster_track: PRIMARY: CRPS skill vs persistence > 0 (95% CI lower bound > 0) at the 30-min lead. TRACKED: pooled ensemble-probability FSS at 20 dBZ vs persistence. TARGET: heavy-rain (>=10 mm/hr) skill. Amended 2026-09-25 from 'FSS > persistence at 20dBZ, 30-min lead'; see definition_of_done.md.
